title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Deleting a folder also cancels the scans queued for it
summary: Yesterday's fix narrowed what a folder deletion looks at, and went one notch too far: files still waiting in the queue were left out, so they were indexed after their folder was gone.

highlights.title: A file created just before its folder is deleted stays out
highlights.description: It is not in the index yet and its scan has not started, so neither list checked yesterday held it. The queue fired afterwards and indexed it.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Deleting a folder in the Explorer while the editor is still settling was enough to hit it.
Folder deletion stays flat at 0.1 ms whatever the session has seen.
